definitions.name: S0A.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0A.MEAN
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: S0A.MIN
definitions.body: 'XS' BIND XS XS 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0A.MAX
definitions.body: 'XS' BIND XS XS 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element as a bare scalar

definitions.name: S0A.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'XS' BIND XS XS S0A.MIN - XS S0A.RANGE /

definitions.name: S0A.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: S0A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER CS [ 1 ] DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

definitions.name: S0A.UNWORDS
definitions.note: join a Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: S0A.TITLECASE
definitions.note: capitalize every word of a space-separated String

definitions.name: S0A.LONGEST
definitions.body: S0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest word in a String

definitions.name: S0A.ACRONYM
definitions.body: S0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word
